subject: Subscription stability flags: renewal action ledger
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Subscription stability flags: renewal action ledger

Team — attaching the Q3 export of churn/renewal signals for the accounts rolling in next 60–90 days. I ran a quick pass to consolidate our top 12 at-risk renewals; Stellar Systems (Deal SS-2027-RNWL-42) landed in the tier we flagged for proactive contract touch because of product usage deterioration + billing variance.

Quick asks so we can close the weekly finance forecast with actionable commits:
- Please confirm stage updates in HubSpot by 9/15 EOD for any accounts you own (update the reason field when moving back to "At risk").
- For Stellar Systems specifically: who on sales/CS will own the procurement handoff and when can we expect a signed MAP? We need a commit/no-commit annotation for FP&A by 9/16 5pm PT.
- Mark any accounts where procurement is the blocker and add short note in the Deal Activity (one-liners fine).

Attachments: Q3_renewal_signal_export.csv (includes per-account signal: usage_change_pct, billing_delta, NPS_flag, legal_hold). I also dropped a link to the HubSpot deal.

Priority: this is an input to Friday's commit ledger — if we don't reconcile stage/commit, FP&A will adjust ARR assumptions downward.

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Subscription stability flags: renewal action ledger

Irene — thanks for pulling this together. Quick updates from the sales side (pulled live from my notes / latest customer calls):

- Stellar Systems (SS-2027-RNWL-42): moved to Contract Review today. Probability bumped to 55% pending procurement signature. Sales owner: Marcus Lin.
- Nebula Analytics: still in Expansion discussions, no churn signal — leaving at 70%.
- Alta Solutions: moved back to At risk — low usage flagged, CS action required.

For Stellar Systems specifically: Marcus has scheduled the procurement sync for Thursday 9/16 at 10am PT. I've uploaded the current MAP draft (SS_MutualActionPlan_v3.docx) to the deal record.

I added a short note in HubSpot under Deal Activity for each change. Will confirm final status after the procurement call.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Sr. Account Director, Mid-Market
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 08:29:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Subscription stability flags: renewal action ledger

Adding the CS perspective — pulled session and health signals overnight:

- Stellar Systems: 28% drop in weekly active hosts over last 8 weeks; two support cases escalated for ingestion errors (CS case #4521 and #4539). NPS unchanged but sentiment in the support threads is trending neutral-to-negative.
- Recommended next steps for Stellar: immediate remediation ticket (ENG+CS), and buyer enablement collateral ahead of procurement call.

Marcus — can you own the procurement runway and ensure the MAP includes the remediation milestones and acceptance criteria? If procurement is worried about stability, the MAP's remediation timeline and rollback/sandbox clause tend to help them greenlight faster.

Irene — I also added a "stability_flag" tag to the deal in HubSpot so FP&A can filter these quickly when pulling the commit ledger.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Marcus / Team — thanks for the summary and for flagging the remediation plan. Confirming the procurement team here; we've reviewed the MAP draft and agree in principle pending the remediation milestones being explicit. Procurement will sign once we have:

1) A short remediation schedule with owners and dates
2) A service-level acceptance clause for the next 90 days
3) A consolidated contact list for post-signature escalations

I'll be on the procurement call Thursday at 10am PT and will have procurement legal on the line. Attaching the procurement intake form (procurement@stellarsys.com — will complete ahead of the call).

Sam Li
Head of Procurement
Stellar Systems
procurement@stellarsys.com
